title: Direct Data Entry Operator I
description:
Description

Westamerica is among the largest commercial banks headquartered in California. We are looking for outstanding people to join our winning team. We reached our current strength because our employees, customers, and shareholders believe in the same fundamental goals: Delivering a wide variety of financial services with a superior customer service guarantee.


Weekly Working Hours: 40


As a Direct Data Entry Operator, under general supervision, perform centralized data entry maintenance to new and existing accounts on the IMPACS, ST, IC, HX, and TX systems and respond to requests received from branches and departments.

Applicant must possess and radiate excellent customer service skills, must be proficient in typing/keyboarding, be able to prioritize work assignments, meet pre-set deadlines, and sit for prolonged periods of time.


EOE

Westamerica Bank's Privacy Policy may be found at: www.westamerica.com/about/privacy
